question: Why are these agents unlike Ananta and others in relation to mantras?
premises: Ananta and others are situated above mantras.
Hierarchical position determines mode of operation.
These agents do not share that higher position.
inference: They are not like Ananta and others, because they are not situated above the mantras.
plain_english: But they are not like Ananta and others, because they are not situated above the mantras.
